title: Implement Automatic UKCAT Classification for Monthly Charity Additions
description:
Ensure the existing monthly charity processing pipeline automatically applies UKCAT classification to all new charity commission funders

✅ COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY:

Implementation:
- Added UKCAT classification to ReviewProcessor class in monthly_charity_processor.py
- Loads UKCAT charity number to code mappings from CSV files (charities_active-ukcat.csv and charities_inactive-ukcat.csv)
- When a funder is added/updated, matches their charity number with the UKCAT database
- If match found, assigns the UKCAT codes from the UKCAT database to that funder in our database
- Applies UKCAT codes during database import (both INSERT and UPDATE operations)
- Handles funders without UKCAT data gracefully (no errors, just logs warning)

Integration Points:
✅ UKCAT classification integrated into import_to_database() function
✅ Classification happens immediately after charity addition/update
✅ Uses charity number matching against UKCAT CSV files (same method as bulk classification)
✅ Maintains classification quality standards
✅ No performance impact - mappings loaded once per processor instance

Process Flow:
1. Load UKCAT mappings (charity_number -> [ukcat_codes]) from CSV files on initialization
2. When funder added/updated, lookup charity_number in UKCAT mappings
3. If found, assign those UKCAT codes to funder in our database
4. If not found, funder added without UKCAT codes (logged but no error)

Features:
- Automatic classification for all monthly additions
- 100% coverage attempted (funders with UKCAT data get classified)
- Logs classification results for monitoring
- Graceful handling of funders without UKCAT data

Deliverable: Automated UKCAT classification for all monthly charity commission additions - ✅ COMPLETED
